mapper.select: SELECT g.group_code, c.code, c.code_name, c.description, c.sort_order FROM common_code_groups g INNER JOIN common_codes c ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE g.active = true AND c.active = true ORDER BY g.group_code, c.sort_order, c.code

SELECT g.group_code, c.code, c.code_name, c.description, c.sort_order FROM common_code_groups g INNER JOIN common_codes c ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE g.active = true AND c.active = true AND g.group_code = #{groupCode} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.code
